name: 32164 · Palm Coast, FL
findings: ZIP 32164 (Palm Coast) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32164 (Palm Coast) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32164 (Palm Coast) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
